THE_FLAGELLANT.title: The Flagellant
THE_FLAGELLANT.description: A cursed character built around resilience and penance.
THE_FLAGELLANT.cardsModifierDescription: Adds cards from The Flagellant's card pool to rewards.
THE_FLAGELLANT.unlockText: Available by default while this mod is enabled.
THE_FLAGELLANT.goldMonologue: They weigh the coins against their conscience. Every coin is a lash they have not yet earned.
THE_FLAGELLANT.aromaPrinciple: Order is a discipline, like the scourge. They impose it upon themselves, and upon all that they carry.
